source.text: (2) The Secretary may— (A) authorize a partner organization to contract for each phase of development, design, construction, renovation, or operation of the museum, or all such phases; or (B) authorize acceptance of funds from a partner organization for each or all such phases.

interpretation: Entity 1,960,876 is a mixed node/edge/category/logical-relation/classification-rule row total, not an entity count, statute count, span count or proved theorem count. Exact per-record-kind counts were not scanned.

The resume checkpoint footer partitions its 443,905 rows into 443,904 span-status records plus one meta record. Its progress row reports 60,068 documents / 22,379 sealed / 421,525 gaps / 3,820,263 pending. Sealed+gap matches span-status rows, but uniqueness and a current complete corpus denominator were not independently scanned; producer counters do not establish successful semantic admission.

Pinned paired-v1/v2 samples are 8 rows each, with 8D raw/projected diagnostic vectors and mock:stable-sha256 inputs. Exact zero projected reconstruction loss is target-conditioned vector behavior, not learned legal-text reconstruction or accepted semantics.

Sample paired sources have span_id,text,text_sha256,legal_id,revision,constitution; no source offset/length or statutory effective-date/version field is present in this nested source schema. revision ipfs-uscode-5016b86a is a producer dataset release label, not established here as a legal effective-date.

Entity schema has legal_id,node_id,src,dst and labels/roles but no source span ID, text hash, source offsets or revision. Sample section nodes offer legal_id correspondence; selected source/provenance edges have empty src/dst. Some footer groups have nonempty endpoints, so completeness and reversible span-to-entity lineage are not established. Complete footer statistics additionally identify at least 1,597,955 edge rows (groups 2–14) whose src and dst are both empty strings with no nulls. This lower bound is not an exact count of all malformed edges; no complete content scan was performed.

Hub metadata has 611 paired-v1 and 80 paired-v2 manifest/shard sets. Card configs expose paired-v1 only. Do not multiply shard count by sample size or sum generations as unique corpus spans; immutable manifests and deduplication must define a processing denominator.

Formula-text manifest is a fixed four-report audit: 56 span observations,45 available documents,11 unavailable documents,372 formula occurrences,328 fallback formula occurrences. It explicitly marks admitted=false, learned_formula_generation=false, independent_validation=false and training_qualified=false; these are not corpus-wide successful formalizations.

Publishing deferred goals does not enqueue or execute them. Sample goal has enqueued=false/admitted=false and retains packet/task/source/observation IDs. Sample compiler/guided agreement remains diagnostic; Lake admission and semantic correctness require independent evidence.
known_process_limit: An earlier asynchronous remote-file PyArrow read printed the one-row checkpoint sample then aborted during interpreter teardown (exit134). This artifact recaptures raw tail bytes and parses synchronously in memory; it makes no runtime/model/benchmark qualification claim.
method: Public unauthenticated urllib HTTP, Hugging Face Dataset Viewer skill, pinned small Parquet samples and synchronous in-memory footer parsing. No target repository module imported; no full corpus download/content scan.

formula_text.notes: Exact captured strings; repeated occurrences retained by document pointer. Reported syntax or validity flags are provenance, not independent checks or Lake admission.

plan_recommendations: Pin both repository revisions and manifest/table hashes; include paired-v1/v2 schema versions explicitly rather than silently reading only card default.

Build a bounded queue from immutable manifest membership and typed source identity. Separate unique sources, repeated observations, goals, artifacts, diagnostics and admitted outputs. Compute exact processing denominator in a separately authorized indexed pass.

For exact legal-text roundtrip retain original bytes plus byte offsets/length, full document hash/ID, source URL, statutory release/effective-date provenance and Unicode normalization policy. Mark missing historical offsets unknown; recover by verified source alignment, never guessed text matching.

Repair and qualify entity-export endpoint preservation before treating this cache as a navigable provenance graph: at least 1,597,955 pinned edge rows have both endpoints empty according to complete footer groups. Rebuild from retained original graph/source evidence, preserve old observations, and test endpoint referential integrity instead of inventing missing joins.

Create versioned span-to-entity edges retaining both source span ID/hash/release and entity node ID/typed relation, immutable source record pointers and derivation provenance. Do not join only on a legal_id or label without generation checks.
Reuse existing diagnostic assets as provenance/negative/repair examples. Do not teach from unavailable outputs, target-conditioned vector matches or failed formula strings as accepted gold.

Keep raw originals, semantic IR, legal-text reconstruction and FOL/TDFOL/Lean outputs as separate decoder tasks and metrics; preserve IR family/schema/dimension/checkpoint/tokenizer identity for 8D/384D/768D paths.

file_inventory.path_population_method: complete pinned Hub metadata sibling list only; no corpus content scan

scope: Inspection evidence only; no new proof/execution/completion/teacher-promotion/distillation/token-saving authority.
viewer_limits: Viewer responses are live service observations with no immutable repo commit response header, even when their schema/row total match the pinned Parquet footer. They are not promoted to byte-pinned row samples.

Span Viewer is-valid/splits returned HTTP500 busy during initial inspection; final recapture statuses are recorded per request. No supported split was established through the Viewer, so no first-rows success is asserted.

Entity first-rows returns100 rows and truncated=true; only bounded sample rows are inspected. Additional rows endpoints request2 records at explicit offsets. Filter requests failed (502/timeout) and are not used to establish counts.
